classifiedFinding.title: View functions (currentRewardRate / runwaySeconds / pendingReward) read stored state without simulating recompute, diverging from what the next interaction actually pays

classification.assetImpact: UX / integrator only. Front-ends and indexers consuming these views as authoritative get values inconsistent with what claim() will pay.
attackPath: 1. Last interaction at t=0 caches rewardRate = R0; dispatcher subsequently routes more mintDebt without an on-chain interaction.
2. Alice queries pendingReward at t=T. View computes against R0.
3. Alice calls claim at t=T+1; _syncBudget pulls the new mintDebt and _recomputeSchedule may produce a different rewardRate, so the view's projection was incorrect.
classification.assumptions: Dispatcher mintDebt or NFTMinter price changes between the last on-chain interaction and the view query.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low. View-function staleness with no asset impact. Per C4 guidance, unused-view-function issues are QA at best; this is observable but minor. Recommendation: document staleness semantics in NatSpec, or add simulated-view variants.
